projectTitle: UNRAVEL: Unlocking New Resources And Value from End-of-Life textiles
projectTitle_zh: UNRAVEL：從報廢紡織品中釋放新資源與價值
tagline: Enzymes and thermophilic hosts for mixed textile waste, plus a 134 euro anaerobic chamber, a 115 euro oxygen monitor and a 68 euro shaker, all documented including the failures.
tagline_zh: 針對混合紡織廢棄物的酵素與嗜熱宿主，外加一個 134 歐元的厭氧操作箱、一個 115 歐元的氧氣監測器與一台 68 歐元的振盪器，全部都有文件記錄，包括失敗的部分。
summary: TU Darmstadt attacked mixed textile waste, of which roughly 92 million tonnes are generated globally each year and less than 1% is recycled back into fibres, by working with two thermophilic organisms: Acetivibrio thermocellus, a strict anaerobe with a cellulosome that degrades cotton at 60 C, and Geobacillus thermocatenulatus, whose carboxylesterase the team characterised and registered as GeoEsterase. Because those organisms need equipment the team did not have, they built it: a movable DIY anaerobic chamber for under 150 euros, a portable ESP32 oxygen monitor when resazurin proved too slow and cumbersome to verify the atmosphere, and two generations of orbital shaker to fit inside an existing 60 C incubator. What makes the work a measurement case study is the discipline of separating what was demonstrated from what was not, in both the enzymology and the hardware.
summary_zh: TU Darmstadt 處理的是混合紡織廢棄物——全球每年產生約 9,200 萬公噸，重新回到纖維的比例不到 1%——他們用了兩種嗜熱微生物：Acetivibrio thermocellus，一種嚴格厭氧菌，具有可在 60°C 降解棉的纖維小體；以及 Geobacillus thermocatenulatus，團隊對其羧酸酯酶做了特性分析，並以 GeoEsterase 之名註冊。因為這些菌需要團隊原本沒有的設備，他們就自己做：一個造價不到 150 歐元、可移動的 DIY 厭氧操作箱；在發現 resazurin 判讀太慢又麻煩、無法確認箱內氣氛時，做了一台可攜式 ESP32 氧氣監測器；還有兩代軌道式振盪器，以便塞進現有的 60°C 培養箱。真正讓這份工作成為量測案例研究的，是他們在酵素學與硬體兩方面，都嚴守「已證明」與「未證明」的分野。

dry.frameworks: Every hardware page is structured as motivation and design requirements, design decisions, bill of materials and costs, construction instructions, materials-processing lessons, testing, evaluation, limitations and conclusion, with a recurring distinction between what was built, what was tested and what has not yet been demonstrated quantitatively. The same discipline runs through the results page, where computational predictions are labelled as predictions and never presented as measured enzyme performance. The team frames its contribution to iGEM as the designs, methods and troubleshooting lessons for working with non-model organisms, so that later teams do not start from scratch.
dry.frameworks_zh: 每一個硬體頁面都按同一結構寫：動機與設計需求、設計決策、物料清單與成本、製作說明、材料加工的經驗教訓、測試、評估、限制與結論，並反覆區分「做出來的」、「測過的」與「還沒有被定量證明的」。同樣的紀律貫穿結果頁面：運算預測一律標示為預測，絕不被當成已量測的酵素表現呈現。團隊把自己對 iGEM 的貢獻定位為「與非模式生物工作所需的設計、方法與疑難排解經驗」，讓後來的隊伍不必從零開始。
dry.dataviz: Interactive parameter plots for kinetic constants with buttons to switch between kcat, KM and kcat/KM across temperature, and between temperatures on the initial-rate plots, with axes held constant so panels can be compared directly; dashed lines for fitted Michaelis-Menten curves and dotted lines explicitly marking measurements for which no fit could be established, so an unfittable dataset is visible rather than absent; absorbance-against-time traces with the blank subtracted and each trace shown relative to its first read; ATR-IR spectra overlaid against simulated reference spectra; collapsible result sections with open-all and close-all controls; an interactive 3D protein model on the landing page.
dry.dataviz_zh: 動力學常數的互動式參數圖，可用按鈕在 kcat、KM 與 kcat/KM 之間切換並對照溫度，初速圖也可在不同溫度間切換，座標軸固定不變，因此各圖可以直接比較；擬合的 Michaelis-Menten 曲線用虛線、無法擬合的量測則以點線明確標出，讓擬合不出來的資料集看得見而不是直接消失；吸光度對時間的曲線都已扣除空白值，並以各自的第一次讀值為基準呈現；ATR-IR 光譜與模擬參考光譜疊圖；結果區段可收合，並附全部展開／全部收合的控制；首頁還有一個互動式 3D 蛋白質模型。
dry.datascience: Enzyme activity is measured against p-nitrophenyl hexanoate as a soluble stand-in for one of the two ester bonds in PET, with the released 4-nitrophenol quantified by absorbance at 396 nm using a stated extinction coefficient of 18,100 M-1 cm-1 under their conditions, so the readout is anchored to a physical constant rather than left in absorbance units. Conditions are fully specified: 0.5 uM enzyme (0.25 uM for the deep-eutectic-solvent comparison) against 0.5, 1, 2 and 4 mM substrate in 5 C steps around 37 C, every value the mean of a triplicate. The initial rate is defined operationally as the highest rate of product formation between two consecutive reads, identified automatically by their evaluation sheet rather than chosen by eye, and Vmax and KM are then fitted by minimising the sum of squared differences in Excel Solver, with kcat following from Vmax and enzyme concentration. Measurements for which no fit could be established are excluded from the table and the figure and said to be excluded, and one suspect value is flagged twice, at 47 C the Thermo MHETase trace shows a single jump in absorbance shortly after the start, so the team warns that the derived initial rate and the fit containing it should be treated with caution. Every plate's evaluation sheet is published as a PDF with the date, the enzymes, the temperature and the notes, including one where well D12 was excluded for air bubbles, so the chain from raw plate to reported constant is auditable. Thermal stability is measured by thermal shift assay with both enzymes on the same plate under identical conditions (2 uM protein, 5x SYPRO Orange, 1x LEW buffer with 10% glycerol, n = 3), and the negative result is reported with its statistics rather than buried: GeoEsterase 74.54 +/- 0.03 C and Thermo GeoEsterase 74.63 +/- 0.13 C by Boltzmann fit with R2 at least 0.998, a difference of +0.09 C with a 95% confidence interval of -0.21 to +0.40 C and a Welch t-test p of 0.34, from which the team concludes not merely that no improvement was seen but that the interval excludes any stabilisation larger than about 0.4 C. Material identity is verified before use rather than assumed, with ATR-IR on a PerkinElmer FT-IR with MIR TGS detector confirming the nylon is Nylon 6 and the polyester is PET against simulated references, and solvent extraction with methanol and acetone followed by repeat spectra used to test for additives and dyes. Particle sizing produced an honest dead end: cryomilling was optimised by ball diameter (25 mm adopted after 5, 7 and 12 mm failed), recovery across 24 runs ran from 79 to 100% with two same-day replicates at 100 and 79%, which the team reads as powder retained in the jar and funnel rather than as a result, saying explicitly it is not a degradation readout; DLS on a Malvern Zetasizer Nano with the serial number and software version recorded showed none of the samples monodisperse with much of the material above the 10 um measuring range, sonication changed nothing, and the team concluded cryomilling cannot produce the monodisperse dispersions repeatable kinetics need and abandoned the approach in favour of weighed fabric pieces. Microscopy covered the coarse end that DLS cannot reach, 3.1 to 40 um for polyester and 3 to 50 um for nylon, with the caveat that only two samples with few particles were imaged so no distribution can be fitted, plus an incidental warning that polyester autofluoresces without any dye because of optical brighteners, UV stabilisers and degradation products. Computational work is held to the same standard: 51 substitutions across five proteins are reported with the explicit statement that a DeepSTABp-predicted +9.27 C melting-temperature change and a +167% TemStaPro score gain answer different questions and must not be treated as equivalent, that 73% versus 97% binding-pocket residue overlap indicates similar identified residues but does not prove correct substrate positioning or catalytic activity, that a substitution 6.55 angstroms from the catalytic serine is active-site-adjacent and not a mutation of a catalytic residue, and that a 28.2 percentage-point increase in near-serine contact fraction across 100 ns trajectories is geometry, not a measured reaction rate, with the roughly 3.3-fold ester-to-amide contact ratio labelled a simulation-derived geometric comparison and not a change in catalytic specificity.
dry.datascience_zh: 酵素活性以 p-nitrophenyl hexanoate 為受質量測，作為 PET 中兩種酯鍵之一的可溶性替代物，釋出的 4-nitrophenol 以 396 nm 吸光度定量，並載明在其條件下的吸光係數為 18,100 M-1 cm-1，使讀值錨定在一個物理常數上，而不是停留在吸光度單位。條件完整交代：0.5 uM 酵素（深層低共熔溶劑比較組為 0.25 uM）對 0.5、1、2 與 4 mM 受質，以 37°C 為中心每 5°C 一階，每個數值都是三重複的平均。初速以操作型定義界定：相鄰兩次讀值之間產物生成速率的最大值，由他們的評估表自動找出，而不是靠目測挑選；Vmax 與 KM 則以 Excel Solver 最小化平方差之和來擬合，kcat 再由 Vmax 與酵素濃度推得。無法擬合的量測從表格與圖中排除，並明說已排除；一個可疑數值還被標記了兩次——在 47°C 時 Thermo MHETase 的曲線在開始後不久出現一次吸光度跳升，因此團隊提醒由此推得的初速以及包含它的擬合都應謹慎看待。每一塊盤的評估表都以 PDF 公開，附上日期、使用的酵素、溫度與備註，其中一份還記載 D12 孔因氣泡而排除，因此從原始盤面到所報告常數的整條鏈都可稽核。熱穩定性以熱位移分析量測，兩個酵素放在同一塊盤、條件完全相同（2 uM 蛋白質、5x SYPRO Orange、含 10% 甘油的 1x LEW 緩衝液，n = 3），而負面結果連同統計數字一併報告，沒有被埋起來：以 Boltzmann 擬合（R2 至少 0.998）得到 GeoEsterase 74.54 +/- 0.03°C、Thermo GeoEsterase 74.63 +/- 0.13°C，差值為 +0.09°C，95% 信賴區間為 -0.21 至 +0.40°C，Welch t 檢定的 p 值為 0.34；團隊由此得出的結論不只是「沒看到改善」，而是這個區間排除了任何大於約 0.4°C 的穩定化效果。材料身分在使用前先驗證，而不是假定：以 PerkinElmer FT-IR（搭配 MIR TGS 偵測器）做 ATR-IR，對照模擬參考光譜確認尼龍是 Nylon 6、聚酯是 PET；並以甲醇與丙酮做溶劑萃取後重測光譜，以檢驗是否含添加劑與染料。粒徑分析走進一條被老實承認的死路：低溫研磨先依球徑最佳化（5、7 與 12 mm 都失敗後改用 25 mm），24 次研磨的回收率落在 79 到 100%，其中同一天的兩個重複分別是 100% 與 79%，團隊把它解讀為粉末殘留在罐子與漏斗裡，而不是一個結果，並明說這不是降解的讀值；在 Malvern Zetasizer Nano 上做的 DLS（機器序號與軟體版本都有記錄）顯示沒有任何樣品是單一分散的，而且很大一部分材料超出 10 um 的量測範圍，超音波處理也沒有改變什麼；團隊因此判定低溫研磨無法產出可重現動力學所需的單一分散懸浮液，放棄這條路，改用秤重的布片。顯微鏡補上了 DLS 到不了的粗粒端：聚酯 3.1 到 40 um、尼龍 3 到 50 um，但附註只拍了兩個顆粒很少的樣品，因此無法擬合粒徑分布；另有一個順帶的提醒：聚酯在沒有任何染劑的情況下也會自體螢光，原因是螢光增白劑、紫外線穩定劑與降解產物。運算工作也守同樣的標準：五個蛋白質上共 51 個胺基酸置換，報告中明確寫出——DeepSTABp 預測的 +9.27°C 熔點變化與 TemStaPro 分數提升 +167% 回答的是不同的問題，不可當作等價；結合口袋殘基重疊度 73% 對 97% 只表示所辨識出的殘基相似，並不能證明受質定位正確或具有催化活性；距催化絲胺酸 6.55 埃的置換屬於活性位點鄰近，而不是催化殘基本身的突變；而 100 ns 軌跡中「鄰近絲胺酸接觸比例」上升 28.2 個百分點是幾何，不是量測到的反應速率；酯鍵與醯胺鍵接觸比約 3.3 倍，也標示為模擬推得的幾何比較，而非催化專一性的改變。
dry.software: Hardware is released as build documentation rather than code: a full assembly procedure for the anaerobic chamber with bills of materials and per-item recorded costs, a step-by-step oxygen-monitor build with the complete I2C scanner sketch and both the simple and advanced Arduino display programs printed in full on the wiki, a wiring table mapping every OLED and sensor pin to its ESP32 pin, and an orbital shaker build with its own BOM, tool list and assembly steps. Nine 3D models and a seventeen-image gallery accompany the shaker, with bearing specifications listed. Plate-reader evaluation sheets are published per plate as PDFs, including the current version of the sheet with a worked example of the layout and calculation steps.
dry.software_zh: 硬體是以建造文件而非程式碼的形式釋出：厭氧操作箱的完整組裝流程，附物料清單與逐項記錄的成本；氧氣監測器的逐步製作說明，I2C 掃描程式與簡易版、進階版兩套 Arduino 顯示程式都完整印在 wiki 上；一張接線表把每個 OLED 與感測器腳位對應到 ESP32 的腳位；以及軌道式振盪器的製作說明，附自己的 BOM、工具清單與組裝步驟。振盪器另附九個 3D 模型與一組十七張圖的圖庫，並列出軸承規格。盤讀儀的評估表則逐盤以 PDF 公開，包括該表的當前版本與一份含版面與計算步驟的範例。
stack: ESP32 NodeMCU with DFRobot SEN0465 factory-calibrated electrochemical oxygen sensor
0.91 inch 128x32 I2C OLED, Arduino IDE 2.3.10, DFRobot_MultiGasSensor and Adafruit GFX/SSD1306 libraries
12 V DC gear motor with PWM control and MOSFET switching
PerkinElmer FT-IR with ATR accessory and MIR TGS detector
Thermal shift assay with SYPRO Orange
AKTA and gravity His-tag affinity chromatography
Excel Solver (GRG Nonlinear) for Michaelis-Menten fitting
100 ns explicit-solvent molecular dynamics with MM-GBSA and MM-PBSA
techniques: Absorbance converted with a stated extinction coefficient
Operationally defined initial rate, selected automatically
Michaelis-Menten fitting by least squares with published evaluation sheets
Unfittable datasets shown as dotted lines rather than omitted
Suspect traces flagged and carried through to the limitations
Paired same-plate comparison for thermal shift
Negative result reported with a confidence interval that bounds the effect
Material identity confirmed by ATR-IR against reference spectra
Solvent extraction to test for additives before interpreting spectra
Recovery reported as process loss rather than as a result
Abandoning a method when its dispersions cannot support repeatable kinetics
In-tube thermometry and leak testing for DIY equipment

good.publicEngagement: A sustainability page sets out the environmental case alongside the science, and the project's framing is that recycling is only part of the answer, with buying less and wearing clothes for longer mattering just as much.
good.publicEngagement_zh: 一個永續頁面把環境面的論述與科學並列，而專案的定調是：回收只是答案的一部分，少買、把衣服穿久一點同樣重要。
good.ihp: Human Practices treats textile waste as a humanitarian problem first: rich countries export their waste and the communities that handle it are never the ones who benefited from producing it. The team quantifies the flow, with EU exports of used textiles more than doubling since 2005 to over 1.4 million tonnes in 2025, Germany exporting approximately 462,500 tonnes in 2022 and second only to the USA, an estimated 30 to 40% of German exports ending in landfills in receiving countries, and Chile receiving about 131,000 tonnes in 2022. They also note that only about 15% of the EU's 6.94 million tonnes of textile waste was collected separately, with 85% going into mixed household waste where it can no longer be recycled, and they sought out textile companies and the local collectors, sorters and thrift stores who keep materials in circulation. Their stated position is that responsible science means asking who the work should be for, not only whether it can work.
good.ihp_zh: 人類實踐首先把紡織廢棄物當成人道問題來處理：富國把廢棄物出口出去，而處理這些廢棄物的社群，從來不是當初因生產而受益的那些人。團隊把這條流向量化：歐盟的二手紡織品出口自 2005 年以來成長超過一倍，2025 年超過 140 萬公噸；德國在 2022 年出口約 462,500 公噸，僅次於美國；德國出口量估計有 30 至 40% 最後進入接收國的掩埋場；智利在 2022 年接收約 131,000 公噸。他們也指出，歐盟 694 萬公噸的紡織廢棄物中只有約 15% 被分類收集，85% 進入混合家戶垃圾，從此再也無法回收；團隊因此主動去找紡織公司，以及讓材料持續流通的在地回收業者、分類業者與二手商店。他們明言的立場是：負責任的科學意味著要問「這份工作該為誰而做」，而不只是問它能不能成功。
good.realWorld: An entrepreneurship page addresses whether biological textile recycling makes economic sense, from cultivation and enzyme production costs to the practical obstacles of bringing the approach out of the laboratory, on the argument that scientific ideas often fail to leave the lab for economic rather than technical reasons. The hardware is the most directly reusable output: the anaerobic chamber is costed at 134.30 euros in materials against roughly 3,000 euros for a cheap professional chamber, a 95% reduction and the cheapest DIY solution the team could find, with the oxygen monitor at 114.60 euros per unit (the sensor being about 83% of that) and the orbital shaker at 68.08 euros. The build guides are written for reproduction, including which parts must be matched to each other, and the team says what it would record differently next time, specifically hole centres, hole diameters, edge distances and fastener lengths, to reduce another team's trial and error.
good.realWorld_zh: 一個創業頁面處理「生物法紡織品回收在經濟上是否說得通」這個問題，從菌體培養與酵素生產成本，一路談到把這套方法帶出實驗室的實際障礙，論點是科學構想往往不是因為技術、而是因為經濟原因才走不出實驗室。硬體是最能直接重複使用的產出：厭氧操作箱的材料成本為 134.30 歐元，對比一台便宜的專業操作箱約 3,000 歐元，降低 95%，也是團隊所能找到最便宜的 DIY 方案；氧氣監測器每台 114.60 歐元（感測器佔其中約 83%）；軌道式振盪器 68.08 歐元。製作指南是為了讓人重現而寫的，包括哪些零件必須彼此配對；團隊也說明下次會改成記錄哪些資訊——具體來說是孔心位置、孔徑、邊距與扣件長度——以減少其他隊伍的試誤。
partners: Textile companies and local collectors, sorters and thrift stores (Human Practices)

images.caption: The DIY anaerobic chamber: a transparent 55 L plastic storage container fitted with 125 mm glove ports, brass ball valves for gas inlet and outlet, an EPDM-sealed lid clamped with C-clamps along aluminium U-profile, and a two-container transfer lock, for 134.30 euros in materials against roughly 3,000 euros for a cheap commercial chamber.
images.caption_zh: DIY 厭氧操作箱：一個透明的 55 L 塑膠收納箱，裝上 125 mm 手套口、作為氣體進出口的黃銅球閥，箱蓋以 EPDM 密封並沿鋁製 U 型軌以 C 型夾夾緊，另有雙箱體的轉移氣閘，材料成本 134.30 歐元，相較一台便宜的商用操作箱約需 3,000 歐元。

images.caption: The portable oxygen monitor inside the chamber, reading 0.5% on its OLED. Built from an ESP32, a factory-calibrated DFRobot SEN0465 electrochemical sensor and a 0.91 inch display in a repurposed plastic box for about 115 euros, it was made because resazurin proved too slow to tell the team whether the chamber had actually reached an anaerobic atmosphere.
images.caption_zh: 箱內的可攜式氧氣監測器，OLED 上顯示 0.5%。它由 ESP32、原廠已校正的 DFRobot SEN0465 電化學感測器與一片 0.91 吋顯示器組成，裝在一個再利用的塑膠盒裡，造價約 115 歐元；之所以要做它，是因為 resazurin 判讀太慢，無法告訴團隊操作箱是否真的達到厭氧狀態。

images.caption: The orbital shaker, built from perforated plate and angle, a 12 V gear motor with PWM control and furniture casters as eccentrics, for 68.08 euros in materials so it fits inside an existing 60 C incubator for thermophilic cultures.
images.caption_zh: 軌道式振盪器，以沖孔板與角鐵、一具帶 PWM 控制的 12 V 齒輪馬達，加上家具滑輪作為偏心件製成，材料成本 68.08 歐元，因此能塞進現有的 60°C 培養箱裡培養嗜熱菌。

images.caption: ATR-IR spectrum of the team's polyester sample overlaid on a simulated PET reference, recorded on a PerkinElmer FT-IR with MIR TGS detector. Material identity was confirmed before any degradation experiment, rather than assumed from the label.
images.caption_zh: 團隊聚酯樣品的 ATR-IR 光譜，疊在模擬的 PET 參考光譜上，以 PerkinElmer FT-IR 搭配 MIR TGS 偵測器量測。材料身分在任何降解實驗之前就先確認，而不是照標籤假定。

gemsTakeaway: Report a null result with the interval that bounds it: measuring both enzyme variants on the same plate under identical conditions let the team say not just that the engineered variant was no more stable, but that the data exclude any stabilisation larger than about 0.4 C, which is a usable constraint rather than an absence of evidence.
gemsTakeaway_zh: 報告虛無結果時，要附上框住它的區間：把兩個酵素變異體放在同一塊盤、以完全相同的條件量測，團隊因此不只能說工程化變異體並沒有更穩定，還能說資料排除了任何大於約 0.4°C 的穩定化效果——這是一個可用的約束條件，而不是「沒有證據」。
